# Media fixtures for the live tests

Both files were generated for this repository; neither is third-party content.

- `build-code.png`: drawn with Pillow. It reads "BUILD CODE: OTTER-5813" and "status: green".
- `secret-word.wav`: synthesized with the system's espeak-ng library (`en` voice, 150 words per
  minute, 22.05 kHz mono). It says "The secret word is pelican. The number is forty one twenty seven."
- `build-code.jpg`, `build-code.gif`: the same image saved by Pillow as JPEG (quality 90) and as a
  16-color GIF, for the image decoder and tracer tests.
